They used df_clean dropping rows with missing flipper_length_mm. The estimand is mean flipper length across all penguins, but missing values are excluded. Is that acceptable? GROUNDING: Claims: Gentoo highest mean, values 189.95, 195.82, 217.19 mm. These numbers appear in printed output. Yes. The claim "using the remaining 342 rows" matches non-null count 342. So grounded.

OVERREACH: No causal claim, just descriptive. Fine.

UNACKNOWLEDGED DATA PROBLEMS: There are missing values: 2 missing flipper_length_mm, one each in Adelie and Gentoo. They note missingness not systematic. They also note missing sex values but irrelevant. No other issues. The output shows missing values are not many. No impossible values. So they acknowledge missingness. Good.

FALSE PREMISE: No false premise. They didn't assume something unsupported. They said missingness not systematic, but they provided evidence that missing values are in two species, not concentrated. That's reasonable.

Thus answer is sound. Verdict accept, issues empty.
